description:
_project/decisions/behind-pr-occurrence-throughput-2026-08-16.md line 19 states "p50 31.3 min". Its cited evidence, _project/audits/behind-pr-occurrence-throughput-2026-08-16.md line 41, states 27.5. The decision also says "50% of gaps under 31 min" where the audit says 51.5%.

This is a STALENESS defect, not a day-one misread. Both files originally said 31.3 over 32 gaps (0dd61b48b, PR #1756). PR #1774 (fe3b352c0) recomputed the audit to 27.5 over 33 gaps and left the sibling decision record untouched. So the miss belongs to #1774's follow-up sweep, and any correction should say so rather than implying the 2026-08-16 author wrote 31.3 against a 27.5 table.

Beware a near-miss in the same paragraph: 31.4 is a required-gate DURATION, not the interarrival p50. Do not "correct" it.

Discovered 2026-08-20 while revalidating why green develop PRs go BEHIND. The concrete harm is that the decision record is the summary readers quote; the wrong figure was propagated into a session report before the audit was checked. Priority is low because 27.5 vs 31.3 does not change the decision's conclusion that gate duration is a material fraction of interarrival.

Both files are Accepted records, so correct by dated erratum rather than a silent overwrite of history.
